name: Yaezakura Koume
source:
"Well, are you the one who will take my first time, I wonder!?"

Likes: A shrine maiden's duty

A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps" and the class president. She looks tidy and gives out the [i]yamato nadeshiko[/i] vibe, but on the inside, she is a strong-willed and dependable woman.

She keeps a close watch on the perverted [url=/c125620]Shinra[/url], and whenever he does something wild, she often scolds him. On the other hand, due to her leader-like nature, she is the type of person who tends to act on her own, in that case, on the contrary, Shinra is the one who supports her.

Because her family owns a shrine, she has been a [i]miko[/i] since she was young. She is proud of her role as a [i]miko[/i], for that reason, the item she has received from the witch seems a bit dubious......?

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/koume.html]official website[/url]]
